meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 给 Claude 接上一个真实手机号(Dial 平台),既能收发短信,也能接 AI 语音来电。安装时它会复制 Dial 适配器、注册频道、登录 Dial 账号、绑定号码,并让你用手机发一次验证码完成配对。
howto.when: 当你要给 Claude 加一个真实电话号码、用它收发短信或接 AI 语音来电时,就运行这个技能;它随后带你走完登录、选号和配对流程。

say.text: 帮我给 Claude 加一个 Dial 电话号码
say.note: 它会复制适配器、登录 Dial 并绑定号码

say.text: 这个号码只允许我自己的手机发短信进来
say.note: 把该线路设为 owner/strict,其他人被拒

say.text: 把这行号码的来电问候语改一下,先问对方来意
say.note: 设置这条线路的 inbound instruction

howto.what_en: Gives Claude a real phone number on the Dial platform (getdial.ai) for both SMS and AI voice calls. Installing it copies the Dial adapter, registers the channel, signs in to Dial, provisions the number, and pairs your phone with a one-time code.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want Claude to have a real phone number for texting or answering AI voice calls. It then walks through Dial sign-in, line selection and phone pairing.

say_en.text: Add a Dial phone number to Claude
say_en.note: copies the adapter, signs in, binds the number

say_en.text: Only my own phone may text this number
Change this line's inbound call greeting
